decisions.description: Korean translation followed by parenthetical Pali lemma is allowed only when all Pali runs in the segment are covered and no independent human-review signal exists.
Pali lemma quoted as object of explanation in atthakatha/tika is allowed only when all Pali runs are covered and no independent human-review signal exists.
Only Pali runs not covered by allowed parenthetical, grammar quote, lemma discussion, proper-name, or terms rules remain human-needed.
grammar_uncertain is never auto-accepted by deterministic classifier; hints may be used only for ordering.

note: This file records rules applied during this run. Editing it does not change classifier behavior.
